accepted.content: Paper records containing `## PDF page N` headings become overlapping forward windows of up to four exact page regions. The first window includes any title preamble before PDF page 1, and the final three windows shorten at the end of the record. Other records remain one full-record passage. Whitespace trimming changes the character bounds so `record.body[start:end]` always equals the persisted text exactly.
